title: SHort course of Amoxicilline for eRysipElas II
official: Comparing short to standard amoxicillin course for eRysipElas: a non-inferiority randomized controlled trial .SHARE II
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate that a short course (5 days) of amoxicillin 50 mg/kg is not inferior to the usual course (10 days) to achieve complete erysipelas remission at day 12+/-2 confirmed by a central independent committee blinded adjudicated from the intervention received, using photos and clinical datas.
conditions: Adults diagnosed with lower limbs erysipelas
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients ≥ 18 years
2. Absence of cutaneous necrosis
3. Absence of crepitations (crepitation = perception identical to that of cutaneous emphysema
4. Affiliated to a social security scheme
5. Who, after the nature of the study has been explained to them, and prior to any protocol specific procedures being performed, have given written consent according to local regulatory requirements
6. Clinical signs of leg erysipelas ≤ 5 days defined by the association of :  Warmth, erythema and/or edema (induration of the skin and/or subcutaneous tissue) and/or pain (NRS≤8)
7. Shiver, feverish sensation or fever experienced by the patient ≤ 5 days or fever measured by the physician ≥ 38°C
8. Severity score ≥ 3 scored on three criteria : edema, erythema, pain with the following scales (0= none, 1=moderate, 2=severe)
9. Absence of erysipelas ≤ 12 mois
10. Absence of blisters
11. Absence of solid purpura (purple tablecloth not erasing at vitro-pressure)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Allergy to ß lactam, intolerance to fructose
2. Patient with comorbidity: known active hepatitis, chronic kidney failure or hepatocellular insufficiency
3. Patient unable to temporarily stop a long-term treatment as antibiotics or corticosteroids
4. Anti-cancer, immunotherapy or immunosuppressive therapy ≤ 6 months
5. Pregnant women or breastfeeding
6. Patient under guardianship or curatorship, legal protection or protection of justice
7. Participation in other Clinical Trial, interventional study, investigational study or performance study
8. Any medical, mental, psychological or psychiatric condition considered by the investigator as compromising patient completion or understanding of the study
9. Weight < 40 kg or > 105 kg
10. Use of oral antibiotic within 5 days (excluding one or two antibiotic intake ≤ 24 hours)
11. Dermohypodermitis requiring hospitalization
12. Erysipelas bilateral
13. Abscess
14. Lymphedema requiring permanent contention
15. Animal bite ≤ 7 days
16. HIV positive
